items.title: THE UNTOLD PODCAST EPISODE 1
items.description:
Real conversations. Bigger horizons. 🌍🎙️

In this episode of The Untold Podcast, we sit down with Laurine — GRC Representative and BIB Year 2 student at MUBS — for a powerful conversation on leadership, connections, and life beyond campus.

Laurine opens up about her journey as a student leader, the lessons she's learned along the way, and what it truly takes to build meaningful connections that last beyond university. Whether you're a student, a young professional, or someone navigating the next phase of life, this episode is packed with gems you don't want to miss.

Some stories deserve to be heard. This is one of them.
